header_sentences: See Sabbath, Today, and Tomorrow; and also see Time, Three.

contexts.text: The six days or times, which are so many successive states of man's regeneration, are in general as follows. AC 62.
The most ancient time... is called in the Prophets the days of antiquity, and also the days of eternity.
All things of the Lord are compared to day, because they belong to the light; and all things proper to man are compared to night, because they belong to darkness.
Nothing is more common in the Word than for day to be taken for time itself. Illustrated.
As day is taken for time, it is also taken for the state of that time. Illustrated.
After the spirit of God... has brought forth into day the Knowledges of truth and good...
Concerning the man who is to be regenerated, in Zechariah: That shall be one day known to Jehovah; not day, nor night; at the time of evening there shall be light ().
Love is the great luminary which has dominion by day (); faith from love is the lesser luminary which has dominion by night. AC 32. AC 709.
The days of affliction () = his miserable state in the other life.

It is said that the luminaries shall be for signs, and for stated times, and for days, and for years ()... There are changes of spiritual and celestial things, in the universal, and in the singulars, which are compared to the changes of the days and the years: the changes of the days are from morning to noon, thence to evening, and through night to morning. (See Change.)
To have dominion in the day, and in the night (): day means good; night, evil; wherefore goods are called works of the day, and evils, works of the night.
There scarcely intervene days after the decease of the body before they are in the other life.
The celestial man is the seventh day, in which the Lord rests.

The aura or breath of the day () = the time when the Church still had a residue of perception... The most ancient people compared the states of the Church to the times of the day and night; to the times of the day while it was still in light... The Lord also calls a state of faith day, and a state of no faith night; as in John: I must work the works of Him that sent Me while it is day; the night cometh, when no one can work (). The states of man's regeneration are also called days in .
All the days of thy life () = even to the end of that Church. AC 271.
The end of the days () = the advance of time.
The days of eternity () = the Most Ancient Church; the ancient years = the Ancient Church. AC 2906:6.

Days () = times and states in general. It is very common in the Word to call all time days;wherefore, also, the states of times in general are also signified by days; and when years are added, by the times of the years are signified the quality of the states, thus states in special.
Days = states in general; and years, states in special. Illustrated.

In the sense of the letter it cannot but seem that day = time; but in the internal sense it = state: the Angels who are in the internal sense of the Word, do not know what time is... thus not what a day and a year are; but they know what states are, and their changes. Example(s). AC 493.

It came to pass at the end of forty days () = the duration of the former state, and the beginning of the following one... As the state after temptations is here treated of, it is said forty days, but not forty nights;the reason is that charity now begins to appear, which in the Word is compared to day, and is called day; and the faith which precedes, being not yet so closely conjoined with charity, is compared to night, and is called night.

Every entire period is marked out in the Word by a day, a week, a month, or a year, even if it were a hundred or a thousand years; as the days mentioned in , by which are signified the periods of the regeneration of the man of the Most Ancient Church. In the internal sense a day and a year have no other signification than time, and as they = time, they = state. Illustrated. AC 9037.
Still in all the days of the earth () = all time; for a day = time...
Day and night () = the state of a regenerate man as to intellectual things, the alternations of which are those of day and night. Explained.
The Most Ancient Church and the Ancient Churches are the days of eternity, and the years of generation and generation ().
A year in the Word, as a day, and a week = a whole period, less or greater, of fewer or of more years; nay, abstractedly, a period.
Under Dawn, see these references. AC 1837. AC 2294.
The last time of the Church is therefore signified by the third day, the third week, etc.
The day of Jehovah () = the last time and state of the Church, AC 1860:3, Illustrated.
In the selfsame day () = that state which has been spoken of. Day, in the internal sense, = state.
In the selfsame day () = then. Day = time and state. References.
As soon as his bodily things grow cold, which takes place after some days, he is resuscitated by the Lord...

Entering into days () = that the time was at hand. A day in the Word, as also a year, nay, in general, time, = state; therefore, here, to enter into days = to enter into that state in which He would put off the human; thus, that the time was at hand.
The states of the Church are in the Word compared to the times of the year, and to the times of the day... namely, its noon, evening, night, and morning...
I must work the works of Him that sent Me while it is day... Day = the time and state when there are good and truth; night, when there are evil and falsity.
The third day () = the judgment, or the Advent of the Lord; thus the drawing nigh of His Kingdom. AC 2788:2. AC 2788:3, Illustrated.
In the day when he weaned Isaac () = a state of separation. Day = state.
Days = the state of the thing treated of.
In the third day () = what is complete, and the beginning of sanctification. Day in the Word = state.
Seventy years () = an entire period, from the beginning of the Church's existence until it expires, which also is the days of one king.
The days of old and the years of the ages () = (the Most Ancient and the Ancient) Churches.
Abraham being old came to days () = when the state was at hand that the Lord's Human should become Divine... Day = state. References.
A day or ten, afterwards thou shalt go () = a state of departure which appears to them full. Day = state.
These are the days of the years of the lives of Abraham which he lived () = the representative state of the Lord as to the essential Divine... Days and years = states.
Her days were fulfilled to bring forth () the first state of effect. Days = states.

The reason it should be seven days with its mother (), was that the seventh day signified the celestial man; and the reason why on the eighth day it was to be given to Jehovah, was that the eighth day = what is continuous from a new beginning; namely, what is continuous of love.
It came to pass, because the days were prolonged to him () = a state of reception... Days = states.
The days of Abraham his father () = time and state antecedent as to truths... Days = time and state. References.
It came to pass in that day () = the state (of doctrine).
Even to this day () = the perpetuity of the state. AC 4304. AC 4316.
I know not the day of my death () = life in the Natural. Day = state... Thus by the day of death is signified a state of resuscitation to life.
The days of mourning () = the inversion of the state.
Tarry with him some days () = what is successive... Days = times and states.
Days upon the land () = states of good thence in the Lord's Kingdom. Days = states.
Those days () = the states in which the Church would then be.
The days being shortened () = a state of removal.
Behold, as yet the day is great () that the state was now advancing.

He dwelt with him a month of days () = a new state of life... A month of days = a new state... When a year, month, or day is mentioned in the singular, it = a whole state, thus the end of the former and the beginning of the following one.
They were in his eyes as some days in his loving her () = a state of love... Days = states.
Because my days are fulfilled that I may come to her () = that now is the state. Days = states.
Reuben went in the days of harvest () = faith as to its state of love and charity. Days = states.
He put a way of three days between himself and Jacob () = their state quite separated... Days = states.
Immediately after the affliction of those days () = the state of the Church as to the truth which is of faith... Days = states.

It was told Laban on the third day () = the end of conjunction. The third day = what is last, and also what is complete, thus the end, and also the beginning; for the end of a state of conjunction is the beginning of the following state, which is one of separation, which state is also here signified by the third day.
In the day the heat devoured me, and the cold in the night () = temptations... Day = a state of faith or truth, which is then at its height; and night a state of no faith or truth.

Of that day and hour knoweth no one () = that the state of the Church at that time would not appear to anyone, either on earth or in Heaven. By day and hour here are not meant day and hour, or time, but the state as to good and truth.
Esau returned in that day to his way to Seir () = the state of Divine natural good at that time to which the goods of truth were adjoined. Day = state.
It came to pass on the third day () = what is continuous even to the end. The third day = what is complete from beginning to end, thus also what is continuous. Explained, Illustrated.
Who answered me in the day of my straitness () = in a state in which he preferred truth to good. Day = state.
And the days of Isaac were () = the state now of the Divine Rational. Days = states.
Old and full of days () = what is new of life... Full of days = a full state.
He mourned over his son many days () = a state of mourning for destroyed good and truth... Days = states; here, states of great mourning, because it is said many days.
The days were multiplied () = a change of state... For day, or time, in the internal sense, is state.
There are no days and years there, because the Sun there... is always rising and never sets.

To build according to the days of eternity () = according to the state of the Church in ancient times; that state, and that time, in the Word, are called the days of eternity, and the days of an age, and also those of generation and generation.
She spake to Joseph day by day () = thought concerning that thing... Day by day, or every day = intensely.
They were for days in custody () = that they were a long time in a state of rejection. Days = states; here, therefore, for days = a long time in a state.
The three shoots are three days () = continuous derivations even to the last... Days = states.

Yet within three days () = then what is new... Days = states... Hence it is evident that three days = a complete state; consequently, within three days, or after three days, = a new state; for after a state is completed a new one commences.
Are three days () = even to the last.
Yet within three days () = that which is in the last.
It came to pass on the third day () = in the last. The third day = the last state; for day = state.
Hence the seventh day was made holy.
Wherefore, in the representative Church the days commenced in the evening.

This state (of desolation and vastation) is called the great day of Jehovah, the day of wrath and of His vengeance, the day of darkness and of thick darkness, of cloud, and of dimness, the day of visitation, also the day when the earth will perish, thus the last day, and the day of judgment; and as they have not understood the internal sense of the Word they have hitherto supposed that it is the day when the earth will perish... not knowing that by day here is signified state, and by the earth, the Church; thus by the day when the earth will perish, the state when the Church will be destroyed.

Joseph said to them on the third day () = the perception of the Celestial of the Spiritual concerning those truths separated from itself, when fulfilment has taken place... In the third day = the last state when there comes a new one, thus when fulfilment has taken place.
I shall sin against thee in all days () = that the Church will no longer possess any good... In all days = in perpetuity, thus no longer.
The last time of the Church and its destruction, is called the day of Jehovah's anger.

Day () = truth from good; night, falsity from evil. It is the first time of the Church which is meant by day, for truth is then received because they are in good; and it is the last time which is signified by night, for then nothing of truth is received because they are not in good.
How many are the days of the years of thy life? () = concerning the state of the natural life from the spiritual. Days, and also years = states.
The days of the years of my sojournings () = concerning what is successive of life. Days and years = states.
Few and evil have been the days of the years of my life () = that the state of the natural life is full of temptations. Days and years = states.
And have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers () = that he was not raised to the state of their life. Day and years of life = states of the spiritual life.
Even to this day () = to eternity.
The day of Jacob, the years of his life, was seven years and a hundred and forty years () = the general state and its quality.
The days of Israel drew near for dying () = the state immediately before regeneration... Days = states.
From then even to this day () = continually. Today, and to this day = what is perpetual and eternal...
He blessed them in this day () = foresight and providence to eternity... In this day, or today = what is eternal.

I will tell you what shall happen at the end of the days () = the quality of the state of the Church in that order in which they then were... The end of the days = the last of the state, in which they are together; for days = states.
Forty days were fulfilled to him () = a state of preparation through temptations... Days = states.
Seventy days () = a full state.
In order to do according to this day () = that it is according to order from eternity... According to this day = from eternity.
Some myriads of men flow thither daily.
It came to pass in those days and Moses grew () = when these states lasted, and increase in scientific truths. Days = states.
The day of killing () = the time of the vastation of the Church, when there is no longer any faith because no charity. AC 8902:6.
It came to pass in these many days () = after many changes of state. Days = states.
Pharaoh commanded in that day () = the cupidity of infesting the truths of the Church while in that state... Day = state.
Fulfil your works, the word of a day in its own day () = that they should serve falsities so called in every state... The word of a day in its own day = in every state. AC 7157.

It came to pass in that day Jehovah spake to Moses in the land of Egypt () = the state of the Church at the time when command was given by the law from the Divine to those who were of the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom, while still in the vicinity of those in the Hells. Day = state.

All that day, and all that night () = everything of perception, both obscure and not obscure, with those who infest, that it was destroyed. Day = a state of perception not obscure; night = a state of obscure perception; for the times of the day... correspond to the enlightenments which are of intelligence and wisdom; thus to perceptions; in general, day and night.
For three days () = a full state. Explained.
Even in the first day ye shall make leaven to cease from your houses () = that nothing false whatever shall be in good. The first day = the beginning of that state. AC 7891.
From the first day even to the seventh day () = a holy full state. Seven days = a holy state, and also a full state.
In the seventh day there shall be a holy convocation for you () = thus in the end of the state. The seventh day, which was the last one of the feast, = the end thereof.
For seven days () = the entire period of this state. Seven days = a holy state, and also an entire period from beginning to end, or a full state: the same as a week.
It came to pass in this same day () = a state of the Lord's presence. Day = time and state.
In the seventh day a feast to Jehovah () = the holy worship of the Lord. The seventh day = a holy state.
In the fifteenth day of the second month () = the state relatively... Month = the end of a former state and the beginning of a following one, thus a new state; day = state in general. References.
They shall gather the word of a day in its own day () = constantly for the necessity. Explained.
It shall be in the sixth day () = in the end of each state. Day = state. AC 8488.

Six days shall ye gather it () = the reception of truth before it is conjoined with good. Six days = a state of combat and labour; here, a state of the reception of truth, or the state in which good is acquired through truth, for in this state there are combat and labour...
They have no holy days (in Jupiter).
In this day () = at that time... Day = state; wherefore, in this day = at the time when there is fulness of state.
Under Combat, see this reference.
The prior state (of regeneration) is signified by the six days which precede the seventh, and the posterior state by the seventh day. AC 9431:end.
That thy days may be prolonged upon the Land () = the consequent state of life in Heaven... Thy days = the state of life.
It treats here of the last time of the Church, when there are no longer any faith and charity, which time is the cruel day of Jehovah... ().
The day of Jehovah () = the last state, or the last time of the Church, when there is no longer any truth, but in the place of truth there is falsity.
If he shall continue a day or two () = a state of life remaining even to the full. Day = the state of life; two days = the succeeding state, thus a full state.
The days of Elias () = the state of reception of truth Divine from the Word at that time... Days = states.
Seven days shall it be with its mother () = the first state with truths. Seven days = the first state of those who are being regenerated; for days = states.
On the eighth day thou shalt give it Me () = the beginning of the following state, when the life is from good... The eighth day = the beginning of the following state.
The number of thy days I will fulfil () = even to a full state. Days = states of life. References.
Six days () = while in a state of truth. Explained.
He called to Moses in the seventh day () = when truth is conjoined with good. The seventh day = the second state, when truth is conjoined with good, or when man is in good.
Daily, or every day () = continually.
Seven days thou shalt propitiate upon the altar () = what is full as to influx into Heaven and the Church. Seven days = what is full.
Daily () = in every state; for by day is signified state, and by the morning of the day and its evening on which the burnt-offerings of lambs were to be made, is signified every state.
To number our days () = to order and dispose the states of life; and the days are said to be numbered when they are ordered and disposed, thus when they are finished; as in .
It here treats of the Lord's Advent, for this is signified by the day of Jehovah ().
Relatively to the time of the days in our Earth, the day (in the Fifth Earth) is fifteen hours long.
(The Spirits of the Sixth Earth) said... that their day is equal to nine hours of our time, which they were able to ascertain from the length of the days in our Earth as perceived in me.
[Swedenborg footnote 2.] It is from this correspondence that a day, and a year, in the Word, = the states of life in general. References. DLW 73:3.
Under Die, see these references TCR 138.

In this first article I shall merely adduce passages from the Word in which it is said that day, in that day, and in that time; in which by day and time are meant the Advent of the Lord. Fully Illustrated.

In these passages, by day and time is meant the Advent of the Lord; by the day or time of darkness, of thick darkness, of dimness, of no light, of devastation, of the end of iniquity, of destruction, is meant the Advent of the Lord when He was no longer known, and therefore when there was no longer anything of the Church remaining. By a day cruel, terrible, of wrath, of anger, of tumult, of visitation, of sacrifice, of retribution, of straitness, of war, of a cry, is meant the Advent of the Lord to judgment. By the day in which Jehovah alone shall be exalted, in which He shall be one and His name one, in which the branch of Jehovah shall be for ornament and glory, in which the righteous shall flourish, in which he shall be vivified, in which he shall seek his flock, in which he shall make a new covenant, in which the mountains shall drop new wine, in which living water shall go forth from Jerusalem, in which they shall look back to the God of Israel, and many similar expressions, is meant the Advent of the Lord to establish a new Church, which shall acknowledge Him as the Redeemer and Saviour.
By the day of Jehovah (; ) is meant the Advent of the Lord, which took place where there was no longer any residue of good and truth in the Church, and not any Knowledge of the Lord.
Their Sun is constantly in its Orient... hence they have no days, etc.
The most, after a period of two days out of the body, are in the Spiritual World; in fact, I have spoken with some after two days. HH 312:4.

Unless those days should be shortened, no flesh should be saved, but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened () = that unless the Church were finished before its time it would utterly perish.
Hence also it is, that in the Word an entire period is called a day; its first state daybreak and morning, and its last evening and night.

Ye shall have affliction ten days () = that this is to last the full time, that is, as long as they will to remain in falsities... Ten days = the duration of that state to the full... because days = states.
They serve Him day and night () = that they constantly and faithfully live according to the truths, that is, the precepts, which they receive from Him. AE 478. AE 478:3, Explained.

That the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise () = that there was no longer with them from the Word any spiritual truth or natural truth serviceable for doctrine and life. By the day not shining is meant that there was no light from the sun, and by the night likewise is meant that there was no light from the moon and stars. By light in general is signified Divine truth... Divine truth in the spiritual sense of the Word is as the light of the sun in the day; and Divine truth in its natural sense is as the light of the moon and stars in the night... These things are also meant by day and night in the following passages. Illustrated. AE 527. AE 527:4, Illustrated.
An hour, a day, a month, and a year () = continually and perpetually; the same as all time. AE 571.

They shall have no rest day and night () = their perpetual state in undelightful things after death... By day and night is signified all time, and in the spiritual sense, in every state, and thus perpetually; for in that sense day and night = states of life.

That fighting against the truths of the New Church (is signified), is because it is said in that great day of God Almighty (), and by that day is signified the Advent of the Lord, and then a New Church.
Illustrated. AR 707, Illustrated.
As it is the consummation of the age... when the Advent of the Lord and the beginning of the New Church take place, by the day of Jehovah in many places is signified the end of the former Church...
In one day () = the time of the Last Judgment, which is also called the day of judgment. AE 1124.
To be tormented day and night () = to be interiorly infested constantly.
Day, mentioned twice () means the first and the second Advent of the Lord.

5. By a day here and in the rest of this chapter is not meant a common day, but the whole space of that time, or that whole time of the creation in which the sun, the globe of the future Earth, and the ethereal atmospheres came forth; for in the Holy Scriptures entire periods of time are called days. WE 9.

And there came forth from the evening and the morning the second day, or the second space of time, within which was made the aerial atmosphere... for with God... a thousand years, that is, a great length of time, are as a day. WE 8. WE 9.
These days are to be called days of creation, and mean entire spaces of time... WE 8.
What is meant by the evening and the morning a day ()... That day = time in general, may be very well known from the Scriptures, for this word means time.
The heavenly changes and revolutions... are represented in the world by days, etc.
On the fourth day after death he (Erland Broman) was called to judgment... On the same day he was at once cast into Hell...

On the fourth day he was taken out thence, and his former life such as he had in the world was granted to him, and on the fifth day he rushed into every kind of wickedness... and was also several times most grievously punished; which was on the fifth day after death.

The days come, when ye shall long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but ye shall not see it (): to long for one of the days of the Son of Man = to long for truth Divine which is genuine in some respect.

In the days wherein Antipas was My faithful martyr, who was slain among you () = in that time and state wherein all are hated who profess the Divine Human of the Lord. Day = time and state. References.
Upon Thy book all my days were written, in which they were formed; and not one of them is wanting () = all the states of life...
They have no rest day and night, saying, Holy, Holy, Holy () = the Most Holy which proceeds from the Lord. Explained.
The day of anger () = a state of combat.
The day of Jehovah () = the last end of the Church, when comes the judgment. AE 721:24.
We are killed every day () = that of ourselves we are always falling into falsities and being led astray by them, especially at the time when falsities reign.
The day of the great slaughter () = the Last Judgment, when the wicked are condemned and perish. AE 405:6.
The casting down into Hell of those who were insurgent... is meant by... the day of vengeance is in Mine heart ().

That they would know neither good nor truth, is signified by the sun shall set upon the prophets, and the day shall become black over them (): the sun = the good of love; and the day, the truth of faith...
The days of the entire () = the states of those who are in good and thence in truths, or who are in charity and thence in faith.
In that day () = the Advent of the Lord, and the states of those at that time who are in scientific truths from the Lord. AE 548:6. AE 654:7.
The day of Jehovah cruel, of indignation and of wrath of anger () = the day of the Last Judgment. AE 413:4.
The reason it said that the sun was made to rule by day (), is that day = the light of the spiritual man, for it has enlightenment and perception from the good of love.

This Judgment is what is meant in the Word of the Old Testament by the day of indignation, of anger, of wrath, of the vengeance of Jehovah. AE 405:35. The day of Jehovah Zebaoth () = the Last Judgment... AE 410:3. AE 514:9.

For the great day of His wrath is come () = the Last Judgment upon the evil... The Judgment upon the evil is called the day of indignation, of wrath, of anger, and of vengeance; but the Judgment upon the good is called the time of the Lord's coming, etc.
By the day of Jehovah's vengeance (), as by the day of His anger, and of His wrath is signified the Last Judgment. AE 850:16.
In that day () = His Advent.
Day () = enlightenment in truths from good; and the twelve hours of the day, all things of truth from good.
The days come () = the Advent of the Lord. AE 768:4.
That the Word shall last to eternity, is signified by as thy days so shall thy renown be ().
The covenant of the day () = conjunction through love; the covenant of the night, conjunction through faith. See AE 527:5.
In that day the great trumpet shall sound ()... These things are said concerning the Advent of the Lord.
The Last Judgment, which then follows, is meant by The day of Jehovah great and terrible (). Illustrated.

These things are said of the last time of the Church, when the Lord would come into the world and effect a Judgment: as there are then no longer any good of love or truth of faith, but evil of falsity and falsity of evil, it is called that day, a day of darkness and of thick darkness. Illustrated.
On the third day () = full reformation and restoration.
Behold, the day cometh that burneth as an oven (): these things are said of the last time of the Church, and of the Last Judgment then.
In those days () = then.
In that day shall a man look back unto His Maker ()... These things are said of the Advent of the Lord and of a new Church then.
Hence, the Last Judgment, when they who are in falsities of evil will perish, is called a day of cloud and of dimness (; ). AE 1135:2.
The days of the voice of the seventh Angel () = the last state of the Church.
A thousand two hundred and sixty days () = even to the end of the Old Church and the beginning of the New Church. Explained.
This revelation and preaching from revelation at the end of the Church is what is chiefly meant by the days of the prophecy of the two witnesses ().
In that day () = the Advent of the Lord.
A day of cloud () = the state of the Church consequent upon truths not being understood, thus, consequent upon falsities.
Three days and a half () = what is plenary; here, plenary extinction.

After three days and a half () = when it was complete; thus, the end of the Old Church and the beginning of the New Church... The reason it is said three days and a half, is that day in the Word = states; here, the last state of the Church. Explained.
The days of the heavens () = the states of the whole Heaven, which are from His Divine.
Three days and three nights () = to the full.
While it is yet day () = while the Word is still acknowledged.
That those Knowledges perish which are not made to be of life, is signified by in the midst of his days he forsaketh them ().
The great day () = the Advent of the Lord, and then the Judgment by Him.
The days of youth () = the times of the Ancient Church.

Which accuseth them before God day and night () = and scolded and disputed with them from the Word continually... Days and nights = continually and without intermission: days and nights = all the states of life; day, a state of life when the mind is in a clear idea; and night, when it is in an obscure one...

The day of Jehovah () = the Advent of the Lord, Who is the Messiah Whom they awaited... But as the Lord did not come for the sake of any kingdom on earth... and as the Jewish nation was in the falsities of evil, and these were then made manifest, it is said, Woe to those who long for the day of Jehovah; what is the day of Jehovah to you? it is one of darkness and not of light.
I. Man should read the Word every day, one chapter or two...
The extremity of the days () = the Advent of the Lord.

They shall have no rest day and night () = continual infestation by evils and thence falsities... Day and night = continually... By day is signified the state of their falsity; and by night, the state of their evil; for as to his thoughts man is in light, thus in day, and as to his affection, in obscurity or in night... Hence there was upon the Tent a cloud by day, and a fire by night...
He shall prolong his days () = the Divine good, which proceeds from Him; for long and prolong is said of good; and days = states.

Of that great day of God Almighty () = the last state of the Church, when the Advent of Lord and the Last Judgment take place... Often is it said in the Word the great day, the day of Jehovah, the day of anger and of wrath, the day of vengeance, the terrible day; and in these places there is meant the last state of the Church, and then the Advent of the Lord and the Last Judgment.
In that day () = the Advent of the Lord.
